description:
Look up the user's depth in a skill domain, with a calibration hint.

Args:
  - skill (string): domain to look up (e.g. "backend engineering").

Returns:
  The matching skills line(s), a behavior hint for the user's level, and any
  custom deep-dive section (e.g. /skills/backend) if the file has one.
name: get_skill_depth
title: Get Skill Depth
